floor5_battle_summary.fingerprint_limit: adapter stateful raw snapshot plus observation; native snapshot omits draw-pile card identities, so equality is not proof of full hidden engine-state identity

limitations: The native API snapshot exposes hands, discard/exhaust piles, player state, monsters and intents but only draw-pile size; fingerprints do not establish exact equality of hidden draw order.

The retained selected-action trace ends at the last supported floor-7 map decision. The final seven Battle search choices are not present as action identities in the retained decision/history artifacts; their Search log rows contain counters and CPU only. The floor-8 terminal is therefore reported from the original run artifact, not independently action-replayed.
The replay diagnoses one owner and does not estimate how common the long Battle is or support a performance claim.

verification.battle_hp_comparison: During BATTLE, compare retained public current_hp against live battle_player_hp; raw cur_hp is stale until the battle ends.

causal_assessment.ordinal_replay: all 1,992 retained ordinals were legal and reproduced retained pre/post screens and public resources
causal_assessment.search_causality: The retained artifact has Search counts and CPU but no per-call root action identities; replay establishes the resulting trajectory, not why Search selected its actions.
causal_assessment.terminal_tail: The final floor8 PLAYER_LOSS and HP 0 are retained run.json facts; its final seven action identities are not present in the ordinal prefix and were not fabricated or replayed.
causal_assessment.turn_guard: The retained floor5 replay reached turn 484; the next supported selected map action entered floor8 at turn 0. Seven later Search calls/transitions cannot reach the Native >500 turn guard.

native_turn_guard.turn_increment_source: BattleContext::afterMonsterTurns increments turn once per end-of-monster-turn boundary

verification.replay_method: LightSpeedAdapter.reset/legal_actions/step directly; no Search, controlled-run executor, controller, or public-history builder
